retrievalProfile.description: A tiered layout featuring a bold red horizontal band with ultra-condensed black sans-serif type above a high-contrast studio portrait on a deep red background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition: a top white header, a central thick red band containing heavy condensed type, and a large bottom section featuring a photographic portrait against a textured red field.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold red band acts as a visual divider and anchor for the primary headline.
High-contrast lighting on the subject creates a dramatic separation from the dark red background.
Vertical hierarchy moves from light metadata to heavy display type to detailed body text and finally the image.
coreInvariants: Horizontal red band spanning the full width.
Ultra-condensed, heavy-weight sans-serif for the main name.
Centered text alignment across all tiers.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick red band with black condensed lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan: starting at the small header, jumping to the heavy red band, reading the subtitle, and resting on the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous white space at the top and structured red space surrounding the portrait.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (top header and text background).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red band contrasted with low-key, moody values in the photographic background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary display type must be extremely narrow with thick vertical strokes.
Secondary type uses high-contrast serifs with sharp terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy industrial sans-serif paired with elegant, airy transitional serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy-weight display style.
Provides the classic mid-century serif contrast for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-tier layout: a white top section, a thick vibrant red horizontal band in the upper third, and a large bottom section with a deep red textured background featuring a high-contrast studio portrait of a person with 1960s styling.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed black sans-serif text centered inside the red band. Add centered serif text in the white space above and below the red band using varying scales for hierarchy.

verificationChecks: Is the main headline ultra-condensed and black?
Is there a clear red band separating the top text from the portrait?
Is the portrait lighting high-contrast against a dark red background?
Are all text elements centered horizontally?

adjustableVariables: Specific serif font choice for body text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact facial features of the original subject

avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red band is solid and not a gradient.
Ensure the display type is sufficiently condensed.
Verify the portrait has a vintage film-grain texture.
Confirm the hierarchy moves from heavy to light text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a bold color-block header with ultra-condensed type and a high-contrast studio portrait to evoke 1960s commercial music packaging.
